findings.claim: Authenticated requests with an invalid Host can bypass the configured allowed-host validation when protocol headers are missing or invalid.
findings.evidence: The protocol gate returned before the inner rmcp service's host validation, and the host regression covered only otherwise-valid protocol headers.
findings.suggested_fix: Enforce the same allowed-host boundary in the outer gate before protocol handling and add combined authenticated invalid-host plus missing/invalid-protocol tests.

findings.claim: The claimed streaming-response boundary is not regression-tested.
findings.evidence: The response test covered only bodies with exact size hints, never an unknown-length multi-chunk body crossing the limit.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an unknown-length chunked body that crosses the limit and assert bounded delivered bytes plus an explicit stream limit error.

findings.claim: The packet adds an apparently unrelated sha2 dev-dependency.
findings.evidence: The isolated C-008 packet baseline omitted C-007's discovery-golden dependency even though the live change uses it there.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the synthetic review baseline so C-007's sha2 dependency does not appear as C-008 scope.
